src='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(x for row in g for x in row), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in g))
    # Extend any repeated diagonal color pattern in both directions along its observed diagonal.
    from collections import defaultdict
    pts=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bg:
                pts[g[r][c]].append((r,c))
    for color, ps in pts.items():
        # Diagonal orientation inferred from neighboring same-color cells.
        slope=None
        for a in ps:
            for b in ps:
                if a!=b and abs(a[0]-b[0])==abs(a[1]-b[1]):
                    slope=(1 if (b[1]-a[1])*(b[0]-a[0])>0 else -1)
                    break
            if slope is not None: break
        if slope is None: continue
        r,c=ps[0]
        while 0<=r-h and 0<=c-slope< w:
            r-=1;c-=slope
        while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
            if g[r][c]==bg: g[r][c]=color
            r+=1;c+=slope
    return g
'''
open(p+'/task-da94f39d.py','w').write(src)
exec(src)
grid=[[8]*14 for _ in range(9)]
grid[3][4:6]=[7,9];grid[4][4:6]=[1,4];grid[5][3]=1;grid[5][6]=4
out=transform(grid)
out
